image_description: A low-angle shot of a pipe organ facade featuring vertical metallic pipes of varying heights arranged in a symmetrical, stepped silhouette. The pipes have a golden/brass reflective finish. Above the organ is a white wall and a wooden ceiling with a decorative wooden hanging element. To the sides are green acoustic panels and wooden framing.

artifact_observations.location: Top of the central pipe cluster
artifact_observations.reasoning: The tops of the central pipes do not terminate in clean, distinct openings or caps. Instead, they appear to melt into each other or end in irregular, jagged shapes that lack the precise geometric definition expected of manufactured organ pipes. Some pipes seem to fuse together near the top.
The reflections on the pipes are somewhat smeared and inconsistent. While metallic, the highlights don't follow the cylindrical curvature perfectly, suggesting slight texture generation issues.
The wooden object hanging from the ceiling has a slightly warped geometry, and its connection to the ceiling beam appears soft and indistinct.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as an organ and not just generic pipes or abstract art.
To check for fusion between adjacent pipes and verify if each pipe is a distinct, closed topology.
To ensure the pipes are grounded in 3D space and not floating or bleeding into the background wall.
To assess overall sharpness and identify any subtle generative blurring or noise.

focus_areas: Structural plausibility of the ceiling fixture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tops of the pipes. In real organs, these are precise geometric shapes (open, closed, or with specific mouth cuts). AI often struggles here, resulting in 'melted' or irregular tips. Also, verify if the pipes are actually separate cylinders or if they merge into a single mass.
